ideas.pitch: An AI-powered urban carbon tracking and sustainable route optimization web app for delivery fleets.
ideas.title: EcoRoute AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the multi-agent optimization and sustainability focus seen in the GreenNovation winning project, directly addressing open innovation sustainability criteria.

ideas.pitch: An interactive AI-powered lecture video indexing and searchable transcript platform for students.
ideas.title: EduSynth
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs a polished, working demo that converts unstructured educational video data into searchable knowledge, mirroring the Data & Design winning approach.

ideas.pitch: A rapid clinical-grade health metrics checker utilizing browser-based rPPG heart rate detection.
ideas.title: PulseCheck Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard engineering and a live-working multimodal demo combining computer vision and health tracking, inspired by the Place Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: A graph-based transaction risk monitoring and fraud detection dashboard tailored for student-run micro-fintech projects.
ideas.title: RiskFlow AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases complex graph intelligence and explainable analytics, targeting the technical rigor appreciated by judges in financial AI hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A real-time disaster event aggregator and crowdsourced emergency resource coordination mapping platform.
ideas.title: DisasterMap Live
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses urgent real-world disaster management with a fully functioning live map and API server, matching the runner-up pattern from HackCrux.
